Important Instructions
  1. All the questions are multiple-choice type and answer all the questions.
  2. This Question Booklet contains 100 questions in all, comprising the following 6 sections:
    Section-A: Mathematics (30 Ques. 1 mark each) — Q.1 to 30
    Section-B: English Grammar (20 Ques. 1 mark each) — Q.31 to 50
    Section-C: EVS (15 Ques. 1 mark each) — Q.51 to 65
    Section-D: Reasoning (10 Ques. 1 mark each) — Q.66 to 75
    Section-E: Mental Ability (15 Ques. 1 mark each) — Q.76 to 90
    Section-F: Manipuri (10 Ques. 1 mark each) — Q.91 to 100
  3. Candidate should write his/her Name and Roll Number in the boxes given above.
  4. Each question has four alternative answers. Choose the one correct answer and tick (✓) it, or write its letter against the question number.
  5. Candidate must read all the instructions carefully before marking the responses.
  6. Rough work is to be done in the space provided in the question booklet only.
  7. Use of calculator, mobile phone, etc. is not permitted.
  8. There is no negative marking.
  9. After the test is over, hand over the booklet to the invigilator.

Instructions: Each question has four options. There is only one correct option in each question. Choose the correct option and tick (✓) it, or write its letter against the question number.

Section-A: Mathematics
Directions (1–15): Factors, Multiples, HCF & LCM. Choose the correct option for each of the following questions.
  1. 1.The total number of factors of the expression 2³ × 3⁴ is:
    • (A)12
    • (B)15
    • (C)20
    • (D)24
  2. 2.What is the smallest 3-digit number which can be divisible by both 4 and 12?
    • (A)100
    • (B)104
    • (C)108
    • (D)112
  3. 3.The total number of prime factors of 3600 is:
    • (A)3
    • (B)6
    • (C)8
    • (D)10
  4. 4.The prime factorisation of 5445 is:
    • (A)3² × 5 × 11²
    • (B)3 × 5² × 11²
    • (C)3² × 5² × 11
    • (D)3³ × 5 × 11
  5. 5.A number has a total of 3 factors. If the number is between 100 and 150, what is the number?
    • (A)108
    • (B)121
    • (C)125
    • (D)144
  6. 6.The smallest number which is divisible by 36, 45 and 120 is:
    • (A)180
    • (B)240
    • (C)360
    • (D)720
  7. 7.What is the greatest 4-digit number which can be divisible by 5, 9 and 15?
    • (A)9945
    • (B)9975
    • (C)9990
    • (D)9995
  8. 8.The total number of common factors of 36, 54 and 98 is:
    • (A)1
    • (B)2
    • (C)3
    • (D)4
  9. 9.The sum of first 10 multiples of 13 is:
    • (A)650
    • (B)715
    • (C)728
    • (D)780
  10. 10.What number should be added to 5436 so that the sum is divisible by 5, 6 and 7?
    • (A)14
    • (B)24
    • (C)34
    • (D)44
  11. 11.The difference between the eleventh and sixth multiples of 21 is:
    • (A)84
    • (B)105
    • (C)126
    • (D)147
  12. 12.What number should be subtracted from 67832 so that the number is divisible by both 21 and 25?
    • (A)97
    • (B)102
    • (C)107
    • (D)112
  13. 13.The total number of factors of 346 is:
    • (A)2
    • (B)3
    • (C)4
    • (D)6
  14. 14.Three bells ring at intervals of 3 minutes, 5 minutes and 9 minutes. The bells start ringing at 6:00 am, at what time will the three bells ring at the same time?
    • (A)6:15 am
    • (B)6:30 am
    • (C)6:45 am
    • (D)7:00 am
  15. 15.The number of distinct prime factors of 32450 is:
    • (A)3
    • (B)4
    • (C)5
    • (D)6

Section-C: EVS
Directions (51–65): Choose the correct option for each of the following questions.
  1. 51.Under the Indus Water Treaty, India is permitted to utilize the water of which rivers?
    • (A)Indus, Jhelum and Chenab
    • (B)Ravi, Sutlej and Beas
    • (C)Sutlej and Beas
    • (D)Jhelum and Chenab
  2. 52.Which of these two rivers together form the river Ganges in Devprayag?
    • (A)Bhagirathi and Mandakini
    • (B)Alaknanda and Bhagirathi
    • (C)Yamuna and Chambal
    • (D)Saraswati and Mandakini
  3. 53.The Ganga river passes through how many states in India?
    • (A)Two
    • (B)Three
    • (C)Four
    • (D)Five
  4. 54.Which of the following is the left bank tributary of river Ganga?
    • (A)Ghaghara
    • (B)Yamuna
    • (C)Damodar
    • (D)Son
  5. 55.The tributary of the Ganga river popularly known as ‘Sorrow of Bihar’ is:
    • (A)Son
    • (B)Kosi
    • (C)Damodar
    • (D)Brahmaputra
  6. 56.India’s highest dam ‘Tehri’ is located on which river?
    • (A)Alaknanda
    • (B)Godavari
    • (C)Mahanadi
    • (D)Bhagirathi
  7. 57.Brahmaputra river originates from:
    • (A)Chemayungdung Glacier
    • (B)Amarkantak Plateau
    • (C)Gangotri Glacier
    • (D)Western Ghats
  8. 58.The largest riverine island in Brahmaputra river is:
    • (A)Quibble Island
    • (B)Majuli Island
    • (C)Bhavani Island
    • (D)Srirangam Island
  9. 59.Which of the following is the Right bank tributary of Brahmaputra river?
    • (A)Subansiri
    • (B)Dhansiri
    • (C)Lohit
    • (D)Dibang
  10. 60.Which is the longest peninsular river that falls in the Arabian Sea?
    • (A)Tapti river
    • (B)Mahi river
    • (C)Narmada river
    • (D)Luni river
  11. 61.Which river originates from the Trimbakeshwar on the hills of Western Ghats?
    • (A)Mahanadi
    • (B)Damodar
    • (C)Krishna
    • (D)Godavari
  12. 62.The only perennial river in Peninsular India is:
    • (A)Godavari
    • (B)Krishna
    • (C)Kaveri
    • (D)Bhima
  13. 63.Which freshwater lake is between the delta of Krishna and Godavari rivers?
    • (A)Chilika Lake
    • (B)Kolleru Lake
    • (C)Pulicat Lake
    • (D)Loktak Lake
  14. 64.Match the following:
    1. Maithon Dam(i) Narmada river
    2. Sardar Sarovar Dam(ii) Krishna river
    3. Nagarjuna Sagar Dam(iii) Barakar river
    4. Bhakra Nangal Dam(iv) Sutlej river
    • (A)1–(ii), 2–(iii), 3–(iv), 4–(i)
    • (B)1–(iv), 2–(iii), 3–(ii), 4–(i)
    • (C)1–(iii), 2–(i), 3–(ii), 4–(iv)
    • (D)1–(i), 2–(ii), 3–(iv), 4–(iii)
  15. 65.What is the correct sequence of the rivers—Godavari, Mahanadi, Narmada and Tapti in the descending order of their lengths?
    • (A)Godavari–Mahanadi–Narmada–Tapti
    • (B)Godavari–Narmada–Mahanadi–Tapti
    • (C)Narmada–Godavari–Tapti–Mahanadi
    • (D)Narmada–Tapti–Godavari–Mahanadi

Instructions: Each question has four options. There is only one correct option in each question. Choose the correct option and tick (✓) it, or write its letter against the question number.

Section-A: Mathematics
Directions (1–15): Factors and Multiples. Choose the correct option for each of the following questions.
  1. 1.The only prime number which is even is:
    • (A)0
    • (B)2
    • (C)4
    • (D)6
  2. 2.The total number of prime factors of 320 is:
    • (A)2
    • (B)5
    • (C)7
    • (D)8
  3. 3.What is the number of numbers which are divisible by both 3 and 5 in the first 1000 natural numbers?
    • (A)65
    • (B)66
    • (C)67
    • (D)70
  4. 4.The sum of two numbers is 300. One of the numbers is 5 times the other, what is the smaller number?
    • (A)40
    • (B)50
    • (C)60
    • (D)250
  5. 5.How many common factors are there for 36 and 90?

    • (B)5

    • (D)9
  6. 6.What is the sum of the first 25 multiples of 3?
    • (A)925
    • (B)950
    • (C)975
    • (D)1000
  7. 7.What is the total number of factors of 750?
    • (A)12
    • (B)14

    • (D)18

    • (D)42

  10. 10.The smallest ODD composite number is:
    • (A)1
    • (B)3

    • (D)9
  11. 11.What is the only number which is a factor of every natural number?
    • (A)0
    • (B)1
    • (C)2
    • (D)10
  12. 12.What is the difference of the ninth multiple and fourth multiple of 12?
    • (A)48
    • (B)60
    • (C)72
    • (D)108
  13. 13.The total number of factors of 2520 is:
    • (A)36
    • (B)40

    • (D)54
  14. 14.Every even number is divisible by:

    • (D)250

    • (B)was
    • (C)dark
    • (D)we
  8. 38.Would you like tea or coffee?

    • (B)like

  10. 40.I wanted to help him, but I had no time.
    • (A)wanted
    • (B)to
    • (C)had
    • (D)but

Directions (51–65): Choose the correct option for each of the following questions.
  1. 51.Under the Indus Water Treaty, India is permitted to utilize the water of which rivers?
    • (A)Indus, Jhelum and Chenab
    • (B)Ravi, Sutlej and Beas
    • (C)Sutlej and Beas
    • (D)Jhelum and Chenab

    • (A)Bhagirathi and Mandakini
    • (B)Alaknanda and Bhagirathi
    • (C)Yamuna and Chambal
    • (D)Saraswati and Mandakini
  3. 53.The Ganga river passes through how many states in India?
    • (A)Two
    • (B)Three
    • (C)Four
    • (D)Five
  4. 54.Which of the following is the left bank tributary of river Ganga?
    • (A)Ghaghara
    • (B)Yamuna
    • (C)Damodar
    • (D)Son

    • (A)Son
    • (B)Kosi
    • (C)Damodar
    • (D)Brahmaputra
  6. 56.India’s highest dam ‘Tehri’ is located on which river?
    • (A)Alaknanda
    • (B)Godavari
    • (C)Mahanadi
    • (D)Bhagirathi
  7. 57.Brahmaputra river originates from:
    • (A)Chemayungdung Glacier
    • (B)Amarkantak Plateau
    • (C)Gangotri Glacier
    • (D)Western Ghats
  8. 58.The largest riverine island in Brahmaputra river is:
    • (A)Quibble Island
    • (B)Majuli Island
    • (C)Bhavani Island
    • (D)Srirangam Island
  9. 59.Which of the following is the Right bank tributary of Brahmaputra river?
    • (A)Subansiri
    • (B)Dhansiri
    • (C)Lohit
    • (D)Dibang
  10. 60.Which is the longest peninsular river that falls in the Arabian Sea?
    • (A)Tapti river
    • (B)Mahi river
    • (C)Narmada river
    • (D)Luni river
  11. 61.Which river originates from the Trimbakeshwar on the hills of Western Ghats?
    • (A)Mahanadi
    • (B)Damodar
    • (C)Krishna
    • (D)Godavari
  12. 62.The only perennial river in Peninsular India is:
    • (A)Godavari
    • (B)Krishna
    • (C)Kaveri
    • (D)Bhima
  13. 63.Which freshwater lake is between the delta of Krishna and Godavari rivers?
    • (A)Chilika Lake
    • (B)Kolleru Lake
    • (C)Pulicat Lake
    • (D)Loktak Lake
  14. 64.Match the following:
    1. Maithon Dam(i) Narmada river
    2. Sardar Sarovar Dam(ii) Krishna river
    3. Nagarjuna Sagar Dam(iii) Barakar river
    4. Bhakra Nangal Dam(iv) Sutlej river
    • (A)1–(ii), 2–(iii), 3–(iv), 4–(i)
    • (B)1–(iv), 2–(iii), 3–(ii), 4–(i)
    • (C)1–(iii), 2–(i), 3–(ii), 4–(iv)
    • (D)1–(i), 2–(ii), 3–(iv), 4–(iii)
  15. 65.What is the correct sequence of the rivers—Godavari, Mahanadi, Narmada and Tapti in the descending order of their lengths?
    • (A)Godavari–Mahanadi–Narmada–Tapti
    • (B)Godavari–Narmada–Mahanadi–Tapti
    • (C)Narmada–Godavari–Tapti–Mahanadi
    • (D)Narmada–Tapti–Godavari–Mahanadi
